summary: Kadant Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its subsidiary Kadant Holdings GmbH completed the acquisition of voestalpine BÜHLER Profil GmbH & Co KG and voestalpine BÜHLER Profil VerwaltungsGmbH (now renamed Kadant Profil) for approximately €157.0 million in cash, subject to customary adjustments. The acquisition was primarily financed via borrowings under Kadant's revolving credit facility. Kadant Profil will be integrated into Kadant's Industrial Processing reporting segment. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The purchase price implies a straightforward cash deal with no premium stated. The 8-K does not provide a timeline for purchase accounting or synergies. Watch for future earnings integration updates; no risk-arb angle as deal is closed.
